visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, reddish-brown hair and heavy makeup is seen in a medium close-up, walking through a crowded city street at night. She is wearing a grey knitted top with a criss-cross lace-up neckline and a grey fur-trimmed stole draped over her shoulders. She looks directly into her handheld camera, smiling and gesturing with her right hand as she speaks. The background is filled with blurred figures of pedestrians, traffic lights, and urban neon signs under a dark night sky. (2) The scene cuts to a different angle on the same street; she continues walking and talking, briefly holding up a smartphone in her left hand. The lighting is warm and artificial, coming from nearby street lamps and shop windows. A man in a white jacket is briefly seen bending over in the background. (3) The setting shifts to a wide plaza filled with numerous trees wrapped in thousands of tiny, sparkling yellow fairy lights. The woman continues her selfie-style recording, waving her hand enthusiastically toward the lens. The environment is magical and festive, with many people strolling in the background. (4) The woman remains in the lit plaza, looking up at the glowing trees with a bright smile. She brings her hand to her chest in a heartfelt gesture and then points upward. The camera follows her movement, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of the night celebration. (5) The video concludes with a dramatic shot of the Taipei 101 skyscraper. The building is illuminated with the word "TAIWAN" in white. A massive, colorful firework display erupts around the tower, with bursts of green, yellow, and red lighting up the night sky in a spectacular finale.
